{"action":"proof","message":"rw [h₀, h₁, h₂] at *
have hz : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num
rw [h₀, h₂] at h₁
apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hz)
calc
  i * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  _ = (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I) := by
    norm_num
    ring"}
